name: Liva Town Square
overview: Liva, developed by Nshama, is a contemporary residential project within the vibrant Town Square Dubai community. Designed for those who seek a blend of comfort, convenience, and modern aesthetics, Liva offers thoughtfully crafted apartments in a lively, well-planned neighborhood. With a projected delivery in Q2 2025, this upscale community promises residents a lifestyle that balances urban energy with residential tranquility, making it an ideal choice for professionals, families, and investors alike.
